value.rationale: It upgrades the original construction from small-coupling perturbative existence to geometrically exact isolated invariant tori for arbitrarily large positive or negative nonzero coupling, and obtains an explicit all-positive-parameter open attracting basin in a polynomial realization. The structural nonstalling argument is essential because the projected time-change scalar vanishes whenever y=0.
